entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7103"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 143</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.143.1-Ps.143.12">Psa 143:1-12</reference>. In structure and style, like the preceding (Psalms 104-142), this Psalm is clearly evinced to be David's. It is a prayer for pardon, and for relief from enemies; afflictions, as usual, producing confession and penitence.</title> <div sID="gen10891" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7103"/><hi type="bold">1. in thy faithfulness ... and ... righteousness--</hi>or, God's regard to the claims which He has permitted His people to make in His covenant. <div eID="gen10891" type="x-p"/>
